header.title: Integrations — connect your mailbox to TalentFlow
header.description: Connect Gmail, Outlook or Microsoft 365 via OAuth, or link your own mail server via IMAP/SMTP — to send emails directly from TalentFlow.

stats.syncedHint: Incoming + outgoing emails via connected accounts

errorState.title: Integrations could not be loaded
errorState.description: Check your connection and try again.

errorReasons.access_denied: Permission denied. Try again and allow the requested permissions.
errorReasons.invalid_state: OAuth session expired. Start the connection again.
errorReasons.token_exchange_failed: Token exchange with the provider failed.
errorReasons.scope_missing: Not all required permissions were granted.
errorReasons.PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED: This connection has not been configured by the administrator yet. Use IMAP/SMTP for now.

providers.gmailDescription: Connect your Gmail via Google OAuth to send emails directly from TalentFlow and automatically read in replies.
providers.outlookDescription: Connect your Outlook or Microsoft 365 mailbox via Microsoft OAuth (Microsoft Graph) to correspond from TalentFlow.

notConfigured.title: {{name}} connection is not configured yet
notConfigured.description: The administrator has not set up the OAuth connection yet. For now, use your own mail server via IMAP/SMTP below.
notConfigured.toastDescription: This OAuth connection has not been set up by the administrator yet. Use IMAP/SMTP for now.

smtp.title: Your own mail server (IMAP/SMTP)
smtp.subtitle: Without OAuth — via your own server
smtp.description: No Gmail or Outlook? Connect your own mail server. Sending works right away via SMTP, without Google or Microsoft OAuth.
smtp.sendWorks: Sending via your own SMTP server works immediately — configure host, port and credentials and send a test email.
smtp.receiveRoadmap: Reading incoming mail via IMAP is coming later. For now we only connect sending.

connected.title: Mailbox connected
connected.description: Your email account is connected to TalentFlow and can now be used for sending.

oauthFailed.title: Could not start OAuth
oauthFailed.description: Try again later or contact support.

disclosure.title: We only get access to send + read emails
disclosure.description: No calendar, no contacts, no Drive files. Tokens are stored encrypted and you can revoke them at any time.

scopes.gmailSend: — send on behalf of your account
scopes.gmailReadonly: — read-only to link replies from candidates
scopes.outlookSend: — send on behalf of your account
scopes.outlookRead: — read-only to link replies from candidates
scopes.footer: Tokens are stored encrypted (AES-256-GCM) and never shared with third parties. On "Disconnect" we remove the token immediately from our database.

disconnectDialog.title: Disconnect mailbox?
disconnectDialog.body: will be disconnected. Ongoing campaigns via this account will be paused. You can reconnect later.
